name: Zoo Code Open-Source Coding Agent
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source VS Code coding-agent extension with code, architect, ask and debug modes; no license fee for the locally installed extension.
watch_out: Zoo Code is the actively maintained community continuation of discontinued Roo Code, not Roo Code's former hosted service. Model/API tokens, cloud inference and external tools can incur separate charges; local models need your own hardware. No free hosted inference quota is included.
